Bug_Title: MS: Field is a mutable collection (MS_MUTABLE_COLLECTION)
Bug_Details:
A mutable collection instance is assigned to a final static field,
  thus can be changed by malicious code or by accident from another package.
  Consider wrapping this field into Collections.unmodifiableSet/List/Map/etc.
  to avoid this vulnerability.
Bug_Explanation: A mutable list instance is assigned to a final static field, which can be changed by malicious code or by accident from another package. This leads to undesired side effects and can cause unexpected behaviour.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggered the bug by adding an additional element to the COLLECTION list in the showBug method. This is possible because COLLECTION is a mutable list that is assigned to a final static field, allowing it to be modified outside of its original class.
